macro.overnight_read: Markets are digesting key macroeconomic data releases including GDP and PCE inflation alongside steady VIX levels (16.52), indicating a calm yet selective risk environment for equities and currencies.
macro.summary: We are maintaining a moderately aggressive posture with a risk appetite of 65 in a choppy regime. Core swing trades focus on defensive and leading sectors like healthcare (XLV) and energy (USO/XLE), while tactical plays lean into earnings and macro catalysts. We continue to avoid lagging tech subsectors like semiconductors (SMH) and communication services (XLC) ahead of major economic reports.
